info.description: Code-derived development contract through upstream main 2de6e41 (PR #14 common errors, PR #15 package organization). AI draft is a proposal only; execution is a local quote-policy/evidence fixture. The F012-F014 Java merchant proposal has no HTTP route. No wallet, signing, payment, fulfillment or real-user acceptance. Outside the mapped F010 draft envelope, unknown paths map to 404 ROUTE_NOT_FOUND; unsupported methods map to 405 METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED with Allow. Recognized Spring argument conversion maps to 400 INVALID_INPUT.
